function_v0.doc:
T\xe1\xba\xa1o m\xe1\xbb\x99t h\xe1\xbb\xa3p \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x93ng Escrow m\xe1\xbb\x9bi (Micro-Escrow Deal).

- `client`: V\xc3\xad ng\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9di n\xe1\xba\xa1p/kh\xc3\xb3a ti\xe1\xbb\x81n (b\xe1\xba\xaft bu\xe1\xbb\x99c x\xc3\xa1c th\xe1\xbb\xb1c `require_auth()`).
- `freelancer`: V\xc3\xad ng\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9di nh\xe1\xba\xadn thanh to\xc3\xa1n khi c\xc3\xb4ng vi\xe1\xbb\x87c ho\xc3\xa0n th\xc3\xa0nh.
- `token`: \xc4\x90\xe1\xbb\x8ba ch\xe1\xbb\x89 h\xe1\xbb\xa3p \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x93ng SAC (Stellar Asset Contract).
- `amount`: S\xe1\xbb\x91 ti\xe1\xbb\x81n n\xe1\xba\xa1p v\xc3\xa0o h\xe1\xbb\xa3p \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x93ng (ph\xe1\xba\xa3i > 0).

Tr\xe1\xba\xa3 v\xe1\xbb\x81: `deal_id` (u64) duy nh\xe1\xba\xa5t c\xe1\xbb\xa7a h\xe1\xbb\xa3p \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x93ng v\xe1\xbb\xaba t\xe1\xba\xa1o.
function_v0.name: create_deal

function_v0.doc:
Freelancer n\xe1\xbb\x99p b\xe1\xba\xb1ng ch\xe1\xbb\xa9ng c\xc3\xb4ng vi\xe1\xbb\x87c (Submit Work).

- `freelancer`: V\xc3\xad c\xe1\xbb\xa7a freelancer (b\xe1\xba\xaft bu\xe1\xbb\x99c x\xc3\xa1c th\xe1\xbb\xb1c `require_auth()`).
- `deal_id`: ID c\xe1\xbb\xa7a h\xe1\xbb\xa3p \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x93ng Escrow.
- `proof_url`: \xc4\x90\xc6\xb0\xe1\xbb\x9dng d\xe1\xba\xabn ch\xe1\xbb\xa9a b\xe1\xba\xb1ng ch\xe1\xbb\xa9ng (IPFS, GitHub, URL,...).
function_v0.name: submit_work

function_v0.doc:
Client ph\xc3\xaa duy\xe1\xbb\x87t v\xc3\xa0 gi\xe1\xba\xa3i ng\xc3\xa2n ti\xe1\xbb\x81n cho Freelancer (Release Payment).

- `client`: V\xc3\xad c\xe1\xbb\xa7a client (b\xe1\xba\xaft bu\xe1\xbb\x99c x\xc3\xa1c th\xe1\xbb\xb1c `require_auth()`).
- `deal_id`: ID c\xe1\xbb\xa7a h\xe1\xbb\xa3p \xc4\x91\xe1\xbb\x93ng Escrow.
function_v0.name: release_payment
